contract.atomicFactSet: Arca按持久无写入Evidence及原Case精确stage discard成功Result作出失败收口决定；单事务expected-state CAS更新原Actor Case为unresolved及stale该Case审批；Foundation只读重验exact Work Definition/failed Event/completed failed Attempt/failed material_commit Effect，Owner重验原Inventory head；证据、revision或Effect状态变化则全回滚；不写执行历史、Event Result、成功marker或其他影片，不自动新建Case。terminal head/Evidence digest提供精确重放
contract.rollbackInvariant: Any participant, revision fence, digest, or CAS failure leaves zero transaction writes visible; no commit marker, receipt, or outbox may survive alone.

crashFixtures.faultInjectionPoints: Owner terminal CAS before and after exact Foundation failure proof, before COMMIT and response
crashFixtures.requiredInvariant: Only a completely failed no-write publication may close unresolved; uncertain Effects and changed Inventory reject with zero Case writes; failed execution and unrelated Findings remain unchanged
